title: Composition of balanced integral scalar reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D, and normalized adic family core C. For geometric spaces T, U, V and scheme isomorphisms g:T→U and h:U→V, assume the ordinary module compositor of C is identity on sections. For every finite coefficient index E and every ambient derived module K over the completed integral coefficient sheaf on V, the inverse balanced derived comparison for g followed by h, postcomposed with the derived native module compositor, equals scalar extension of the completed integral inverse-image compositor, followed by the inverse balanced comparison for g at h^{-1}K and native derived g-pullback of the inverse balanced comparison for h at K. This is the composition square for scalar extension alone; it uses no realization comparison, constructibility or completion-unit inversion.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, explicit inverse-image formula; Stacks 03EL, 07A4 and 0941; agent-formulated scalar-composition refinement

proof.text: For ordinary modules evaluate the two balanced comparison paths on every pure tensor a tensor x. IntegralReindex.sections fixes each balanced map; the assumed native module compositor and the completed module compositor leave x unchanged. RingReindex.functions identifies the composite coefficient value with the two successive values. The sheafified tensor universal property extends this equality to the whole ordinary module morphisms.

Apply the ordinary square termwise to cochain complexes. Substitute the three integralReindexRepresentative equations. The exact-derived composition factorizations identify the cochain compositor with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso followed by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Universal scalar-extension cochain counits determine natural transformations between the resulting total left derived functors uniquely, so the cochain equality gives the stated ambient derived equality. Invert the forward comparison square and whisker its isomorphisms to obtain the stated inverse-component equation.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15, explicit inverse-image formula; agent-formulated scalar-only composition refinement

theorem integralScalarReindexing_composition
    (C : FamilyCore l D) (T U V : GeometricSpace D)
    (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left) (h : U.base.left ≅ V.base.left)
    (h_sections : ∀ (M : modules l V.base.left (C.data V).realization)
      (W : T.base.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((modulePull l T.base.left (g ≪≫ h).hom
        (C.ring T V (g ≪≫ h))).obj M).val.obj W),
      HEq (((C.moduleComp T U V g h).hom.app M).val.app W x) x)
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) V.base.left)) :
    (C.integral T V (g ≪≫ h) E).derived.inv.app K ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (C.moduleComp T U V g h) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).hom.app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l V.base.left (C.data V).realization E)).obj K) =
    (pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l T.base.left (C.data T).realization E)).map
        ((podCompletedDerivedComp l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)
          h.hom g.hom).hom.app K) ≫
      (C.integral T U g E).derived.inv.app
        ((podCompletedDerivedInverseImage l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) h.hom).obj K) ≫
      (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map
        ((C.integral U V h E).derived.inv.app K)
